The transcript shows the check (`-W error::DeprecationWarning`) passes today—all 13 tests pass with exit code 0. Yet the second run without that flag reveals the 2 warnings the issue describes. This means the criterion's check cannot discriminate "done" from "untouched": it reports green both before and after the fix. The check needs to fail today to serve as an oracle. A correct check would be something like `uv run pytest tests/test_terminals.py tests/web/test_terminal_ws.py -q 2>&1 | grep -c DeprecationWarning` returning 0 (currently returns 2), or running with `-W error::DeprecationWarning` in a configuration that actually surfaces the warning as an error.
